Fig. 4 Daytime litter CO2 flux and microclimatic conditions
during the dry season. (a) Mean rates of dry season litter CO2
flux (n = 16, except Calicotome where n = 11), (b) UV irradiance
(n = 12, except Calicotome where n = 8), and (c) chamber temperature during midday measurements in three litter types as affected by solar radiation manipulation in Israel (n = 16, except Calicotome where n = 11). Different letters indicate statistically significant differences within litter type (P ≤ 0.05, Tukey–Kramer HSD test). Mean ± SE, n = 11–20 litterbags.
